name: Checker-bark juniper
desc: Checker-bark juniper (Juniperus deppeana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Juniperus deppeana is a small to medium-sized tree reaching 10–15 metres (33–49 feet) in height. It is native to central and northern Mexico and the southwestern United States.
